flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: Only the front end of refunds exists: the ocms_refund_notice record (OcmsRefundNotice.java, created in PaymentUpdateServiceImpl, PermanentRevivalHelper, CronSyncTxnData) and the PaymentExceptionReportHelper report. There is no code for bank account details, refund advice/status, a Cumulus interface, refund letters, a unique URL or an X-days parameter in the six repos. The Epic46 refund UI routes are commented out in ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:342-371.
note: Status in stories.json is 'No requirement' (requirement not given); the story is traced from its text. Grep with synonyms (refund, bank account, cumulus, paynow, giro, payout, disburse, beneficiary, refund advice, unique url) across the six repos, UI and API, found no code for this flow. All that exists is the ocms_refund_notice record with no bank, payout status, address or letter date column (OcmsRefundNotice.java:20-58), and no job in ocmsadminprivateapi reads that table to create a letter (only PaymentExceptionReportHelper:123-137 reports on it). The Epic46 refund UI routes are in App.tsx:342-371 but inside a comment block and the Epic46 import is commented out too (App.tsx:60). The OCMS8 address mechanism for notices (e.g. ToppanUploadHelper.java:409) is not called for refunds. Tickets OCMS-SR-2026-112, OCMS-SR-2026-190 and OCMS-DF-2026-152 only concern creating the refund record/ID and the exception report, not the bank details flow. Cumulus and PayNow: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim. The feature is not in the code; only the refund record and exception report can be reused. Ask URA in which repo (if any) the bank details and Cumulus flow was built.

steps.step: The refund letter notice/reminder is sent to the vendor for printing and postage
steps.detail: Sending to the vendor (Toppan) exists for notice letters (ToppanUploadHelper.java:409 and the upload job), but no refund letter type feeds into it (grep refund in the toppan folder is empty). Toppan SFTP: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The offender opens the unique URL from the letter to submit bank account details
steps.detail: There is no route/page or URL token for bank details in the Online Customer Portal (grep bank, account, refund in ocmseserviceui/src and ocmseserviceapi/src is empty; 'token' hits are only for file upload).

steps.step: OCMS receives and validates the bank account details submitted through the unique URL
steps.detail: There is no endpoint, entity or column that stores a bank account in ocmseserviceapi or thirdpartyapi (the only PayNow hit is a payment-mode label in ReceiptConstants.java:54-65).

steps.step: OCMS updates the refund advice with the received bank details
steps.detail: The refund record has no bank account column or refund advice status (OcmsRefundNotice.java:20-58), so there is nothing to update.

steps.step: The refund advice is sent through the interface to Cumulus so Cumulus can process the refund
steps.detail: There is no Cumulus integration in the six repos (grep cumulus is empty; thirdpartyapi only has AXS and CES). Cumulus: cannot verify from repo.
